When replacing the navigation receiver assembly on a vehicle subscribed to the G-BOOK service, perform the vehicle linking setting, then perform the G-BOOK use resumption operation and HELPNET service start operation. (see )

step2.ptxt: On this model, the navigation receiver assembly functions as a one-touch type HELPNET terminal and holds the HELPNET on-board unit ID.

The navigation receiver assembly has a built-in hard disk drive (hereafter HDD) for storing map data, etc. used by the navigation system. Therefore, observe the following precautions when handling it.

step3.ptxt: Do not subject it to vibration or impact

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop or strike the navigation receiver assembly. Do not use a unit that has been dropped or struck.

step3.ptxt: Do not allow condensation to form

atten3.ptxt: If the navigation receiver assembly is subjected to sudden temperature changes, condensation may form inside and cause HDD failure. Therefore, store a navigation receiver assembly removed from the vehicle inside the vehicle or in an environment with equivalent temperature, humidity, etc.
Touching the connector terminals may apply static electricity to the internal circuits and cause HDD failure.
Do not bring speakers, motors, magnetized tools, etc. near the navigation receiver assembly.
